contracts.label: lem:normalization
contracts.scope: Every finite simple graph, minimum ordinary polygonal drawing, straight near vertices/crossings, no adjacent-edge crossings. Narrative dependency only; not formalized.

contracts.label: eq:J; lem:cycles

contracts.label: lem:weights
contracts.scope: Distinct N real nodes, barycentric sums vanish for degree <=N-2. Weights are defined in Lean, but this theorem and drawing-chain construction are not formalized.

contracts.label: eq:M; lem:detector
contracts.scope: 2s distinct real nodes, s>=2; arbitrary prescribed order independent of numerical order; G=product(t-u_i); weights=1/Gprime(u_i); signs +/-1/2; pairing nonsingular on full P_(s-1,s-2) x P_(s-2,s-1).
contracts.lean_contract: UpstreamDetectorPremise d t order, with s=d+2. It includes node injectivity and explicit right nondegeneracy of orderPair on the full two rectangles. A theorem argument only; there is no global constant asserting it.
contracts.new_deduction: twisted_detector_from_U4: A in P_(s-2,s-2), all twists (v-t_c)Bprime with Bprime in P_(s-1,s-2) pairing zero imply A=0. Square detector is not used.

contracts.label: thm:main
contracts.scope: Ordinary cr(K_n)=Z(n), every n>=3. Not formalized here.

contracts.label: sec:upper; prop:upper
contracts.scope: Classical endpoint-sum two-page upper drawing with alternating same-page crossings and total Z(n). Not formalized here.
